title: layout: nav item type `component` is implemented but missing from `NavigationItemType` and its zod enum — authors cannot declare it
body:
Found by the full type-check sweep in #2911 / #2915. `@object-ui/layout` had **no type-check script**, so this was invisible to CI.

## Not a dead branch — a half-landed feature

The two type errors look like dead code, but they are the opposite:

```
packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx(222,18): error TS2367:
  This comparison appears to be unintentional because the types
  '"group" | "separator" | "action"' and '"component"' have no overlap.

packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx(463,10): error TS2678:
  Type '"component"' is not comparable to type 'NavigationItemType'.
```

Both sites contain a **real, fleshed-out implementation** of a `component` nav item — `componentRef` is colon-split and mapped to `/component/<ns>/<name>`, with `params` serialised to a querystring, carrying a `// Phase 3b:` comment explaining the design.

But `NavigationItemType` never gained the member. `packages/types/src/app.ts:31`:

```ts
export type NavigationItemType =
  | 'object' | 'dashboard' | 'page' | 'report'
  | 'url' | 'group' | 'separator' | 'action';
```

and `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts:29`:

```ts
export const NavigationItemTypeSchema = z.enum([
  'object', 'dashboard', 'page', 'report', 'url', 'group', 'separator', 'action',
]);
```

**The zod enum is the part that bites.** It is not just a compile-time inconvenience — `NavigationItemTypeSchema` would **reject `type: 'component'` at validation time**, so an author cannot declare a component nav item at all. The renderer code that handles it is unreachable in practice. The feature is dead on arrival rather than dead code.

## Suggested fix

Add `'component'` to both the TS union and the zod enum (they are two copies of the same vocabulary and must move together), then confirm end-to-end that a `component` nav item validates, routes, and renders — the renderer half already exists. Worth checking whether `@objectstack/spec` carries the same enum, since the doc comment says this type is "aligned with @objectstack/spec"; if so, this is a cross-repo vocabulary change, not a local one.

## Closing this out

`@object-ui/layout` is listed in `DEBT` in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` with `errors: 2`. When fixed, add `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` and **delete the DEBT entry** — the guard fails if an entry outlives its gap.

## Reproducing

`layout` has no `type-check` script yet; add the `paths` override its type-checked peers carry, then `cd packages/layout && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`. Without that override you also get ~104 spurious TS6059 `rootDir` errors — see #2915 for why.

Refs #2911, #2915
